focus: Peruvian tax-benefit surface: personal income tax (TUO LIR, UIT-banded), IGV/ISC, EsSalud and pension contributions, Pension 65, and the Juntos CCT.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Peru Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: PERUMOD
oracles.dataset: ENAHO 2019-2022 based input microdata (shipped with the licensed bundle where included)
oracles.role: Household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Peru. Policy years 2019-24. Report CR-PERUMOD-v2-4 (UNU-WIDER).

availability_check.detail: The locally held licensed SOUTHMOD bundle (EUROMOD runtime proven on the Ghana and Rwanda lanes) must be inventoried for PERUMOD PE systems before wiring. Validation frame: PERUMOD v2.4, policy years 2019-24.
